promos.hook_description: Matriarch coldly warns Juliana to turn around before she sees Gerald holding Clarissa's hand.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Clarissa gloats 'Because he is marrying me' and Juliana gasps in devastation.
promos.rationale: Classic wedding day betrayal. Instant viral hook with zero lore required.

promos.hook_description: Gerald publicly declares Juliana is of low value and plainness.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana's despair turns into icy defiance as string drone swells to black.
promos.rationale: High melodrama rejection cut at the climax of Juliana's emotional turn.

promos.hook_description: Gerald coldly opens with 'I cannot marry you, Juliana, you are far too plain.'
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana demands if her sister is a better choice before the silent crowd.
promos.rationale: Unforgiving public shaming with instant emotional tension in the opening seconds.

promos.hook_description: Father commands Juliana to step aside and accept Gerald's rejection.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana publicly curses the wedding union before exiting.
promos.rationale: Family betrayal confrontation with an explosive defiant cliffhanger.

promos.hook_description: Scarred bearded stranger roars 'Take your hands off her' as church guards grab Juliana.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Stranger drops to one knee and proposes marriage in front of the congregation.
promos.rationale: The defining turning point of the series: instant chivalric rescue and shocking proposal.

promos.hook_description: Clarissa laughs mockingly at the broken soldier proposing to Juliana.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana places her hand in Alexander's and accepts the vows.
promos.rationale: Defiant retribution against arrogant antagonists; pure underdog empowerment.

promos.hook_description: Stepmother maliciously slaps Juliana's mother's heirloom ledger into the muddy puddle.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander drops to his knees in the mud, picks up the ledger, and stares down the family.
promos.rationale: Visceral cruelty trigger (destruction of late mother's keepsake) converted into romantic protectiveness.

promos.hook_description: Juliana expects a harsh soldier and breaks down near the hearth.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander kneels quietly to kindle the fire, comforting her in silence.
promos.rationale: Emotional pivot from aristocracy hostility to tender protective sanctuary.

promos.hook_description: Gerald arrives outside the cottage mocking Juliana's muddy hands and poverty.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander looms behind Gerald with quiet menace, making Gerald tremble in fear.
promos.rationale: Arrogant ex-fiancé confrontation where the intimidating warrior husband terrifies the bully.

promos.hook_description: Juliana questions how a common soldier knows rare medicinal botany.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander notices Juliana's maternal crest and abruptly changes the subject.
promos.rationale: Secret identity intrigue; subtle clues teasing Alexander's true identity.

promos.hook_description: Aristocratic conspirators discuss rumors of a dead Duke living in the woodland.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Informant confirms the mysterious soldier bears the war scar of the Duke.
promos.rationale: High-stakes identity reveal teaser; creates urgent binge-watching pressure.

promos.hook_description: Alexander stumbles into the cottage dripping blood down his arm from an ambush.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana tears open his tunic and sees the royal military crest branded across his chest.
promos.rationale: Visceral physical danger transitioning directly into an explosive identity reveal.
